vya_text: dI0-athAnukramaNikAmAha - atheti | athaSabda AnantaryArthe ma~ggalArthe vA | anukramaNikA iti adhyAyAnAmanukramaNaM triKaNDAnAmityarthaH| idAnIM tAmanukramaNikAM darSayitumAha -prathamamityAdi | pariBAShAdirogagaNanAntaiH saptaBiradhyAyaiH kRutvA pUrvaKaNDo~ayamIritaH kathita ityarthaH, AcAryeNa iti SeShaH | te ke adhyAyA ityAha - prathamamiti | prathamamAdau pariBAShA tulanAdikam | dvitIye BaiShajyAKyAnakam | BaiShajyAKyAnakamityauShadhaBakShaNavidhiH | tatheti grahaNAt dravyarasaguNavipAkAdInAM kathanaM RutuShaTkakathanaM ca | nADIparIkShAdividhiriti tRutIyam | AdigrahaNAdiha svapnAdInAM kathanam | tato~anantaraM dIpanapAcanAdilakShaNakathanaM caturtham | AdiSabdAt sraMsanaBedanAnulomanavamanaleKanastamBanAdikathanam | tato~anantaraM kalAdikAKyAnamiti pa~jcamaM, AdigrahaNAt sRuShTikramaSArIrAdikathanam | tathetyanantaraM AhArAdigatiriti ShaShTham | AdiSabdAt garBotpattikumArapoShaNoktaprakRutilakShaNakathanaM ca | rogANAM gaNanA ceti itiSabdenAvaSiShTaM saptamamityarthaH, etena sAdhyA ya uktA rogA jvarAdayasteShAM gaNanA saMKyAkathanamiti pUrvaKaNDAdhyAyAnukramaH kathitaH || 7-8 ||
